newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end with big gains, near peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end with big gains, near peaks.

text.p: Dec 19 - U.S. debt futures ended with big gains, near highs. March T-bonds built on morning rise after five-yr note auction that traders said was average to fairly good. They said good dealer buying in Dec T-bond futures just before the contract expired at noon added support. March bonds hit buystops on rise, posted key reversal that could encourage more buying.
